evals.name: full-audit-before-build
evals.prompt: health check the docs before we start building — audit the whole project for gaps and contradictions
evals.expected_output: Read-only full-project audit in chat: top line with files checked, verdict and severity counts; high/med findings grouped by level with both sides quoted path:line, downstream impact and fix command; low as one-liners; checked-no-issues list by level; ends by asking which findings to fix. No files modified.
assertions: Top line states files checked, a verdict (CLEAN or ISSUES FOUND) and counts by severity
Findings are grouped by severity (high / med / low)
Every high and med finding quotes at least two path:line locations
Every finding names a fix (a slash command or 'manual edit')
Report includes a 'checked, no issues' list by level
Report ends by asking which findings to fix (and does not claim to have fixed anything)
No project file in the copy was modified (read-only)

Detects at least one remaining real issue: standards/index.yml placeholder descriptions, a missing epics.index.yml/products.index.yml, or the wrong design-rationale.md path in INFRA_PLAN.md/design-rationale.md
Covers root docs (design-rationale.md and INFRA_PLAN.md) in what was checked

evals.name: epic-scoped-audit
evals.expected_output: Audit scoped to the accounts-auth epic (its epic.md, tech-plan, brief, 3 specs, specs.index.yml) checked against product docs and standards; cross-epic ownership collisions involving its specs; same report format; asks which to fix. No files modified.
assertions: Top line states files checked, a verdict (CLEAN or ISSUES FOUND) and counts by severity
Findings are grouped by severity (high / med / low)
Every high and med finding quotes at least two path:line locations
Every finding names a fix (a slash command or 'manual edit')
Report includes a 'checked, no issues' list by level
Report ends by asking which findings to fix (and does not claim to have fixed anything)
No project file in the copy was modified (read-only)
Stays scoped to accounts-auth: no findings that live only in other epics' files

Detects at least one remaining real issue in scope: design-rationale.md/INFRA_PLAN.md pointing at a non-existent accounts-auth/design-rationale.md, epic Status 'planning' with all specs shaped, or signup-login tasks.md cancelled-only 'Auth.js' group

evals.name: after-infra-plan-fallthrough
evals.prompt: we've been applying the stuff in INFRA_PLAN.md to the docs over the last few days. did anything fall through? is the softwareos folder still consistent with itself and with the root docs?
evals.expected_output: Full audit that specifically checks INFRA_PLAN.md and design-rationale.md against product docs and specs, flags partially-cascaded decisions with /update-arch as fix, same report format, asks which to fix. No files modified.
assertions: Top line states files checked, a verdict (CLEAN or ISSUES FOUND) and counts by severity
Findings are grouped by severity (high / med / low)
Every high and med finding quotes at least two path:line locations
Every finding names a fix (a slash command or 'manual edit')
Report includes a 'checked, no issues' list by level
